finding.root_cause: The final main_v1 good predicate accepted positive statuses and a PASS from SMT solver_differential but did not compare each emitted result's tool/property/model/purpose/expected identity with its selected case. solver_differential checked all IDs as a set and SMT pair payload consistency, but not TLC metadata/selected-index identity.
finding.counterexample: With original differential.py and main_v1 good logic, selected SMT Z3+cvc5 pair identities/answers PASS, selected TLC ID is present, but its result model_id is replaced by a foreign model_id; original native differential PASS and old good=True while new audit FAIL. Different orphan TLC IDs or duplicate IDs already fail the original global differential: those are not the actual bypass.
finding.impact: Potential false MODEL_AND_SOURCE_PASS in a native case-result corruption/implementation regression even when the TLC result does not correspond to the declared selected model property; not an observed live GitHub Claim/CAS defect.

repair.behavior: Audit every selected case in order against actual returned result ID/tool/property_id/model_id/purpose/expected and known status; block on missing/extra/duplicated/reordered/misidentified/malformed results; if corrupt do not consume SMT pairing as proof. Retain real solver FAIL precedence and emit audit in receipt.
